text:
lena: Quick sync 7: EdgeScale (partner) sent a draft solution brief + marketplace tile. They want a joint case snippet and the co-branded hero on the marketplace listing. Sharing assets in drive. Can marketing confirm logo rules and sizes?

rob-marketing: grabbing it now. Any mandated tagline from EdgeScale? Also need to know if we can use their product shots.

omar (EdgeScale): Hey all 7: permission granted for product screenshots if unmodified. For logos: please use our horizontal lockup on white or our dark-blue bar (#0B2E4A). Avoid placing our mark on photos.

sam-engineering: Heads-up 7: the brief references a "throughput increase" metric. We should either qualify the environment (instance type, sequence length) or use non-numeric language. Marketplace reviewers often redact unverified numbers.

lena: Good call Sam. Rob, can we draft the one-line quote without numbers? Maybe: "Redwood + EdgeScale delivered noticeably faster inference and more predictable costs."

omar (EdgeScale): That's acceptable to legal, but they asked to replace "noticably" with "measurably" if you can supply the test notes. Either works for us.

rob-marketing: I'll go with the softer version for now: "Redwood + EdgeScale delivered faster inference and improved cost predictability."

nina-ops: Asset specs: marketplace hero 1200x600 PNG (sRGB, no alpha), tile 600x600, favicon 256x256. Also request a transparent SVG for partner lockup for our CMS. EdgeScale legal said SVG must not be altered.

omar (EdgeScale): We'll provide the SVG and PNGs. Note: trademark policy requires a 12px clear zone and no rotation.

legal-bot: Reminder: any partner logos used in public-facing assets must be accompanied by a signed brand permission doc stored in /legal/partner-logos. Please attach the permission PDF to #legal-approvals. Performance claims require either a test appendix or removal of numeric claims.

rob-marketing: Understood. Omar, can you upload the permission PDF and the SVG to the shared folder?

omar (EdgeScale): Done 7: uploaded edge-logos.svg and edge-permission-v1.pdf to the shared drive.

lena: Two more asks: (1) can we include a brief quote graphic (logo + one-line quote) for the marketplace hero? (2) would EdgeScale like a co-run webinar to kick off the listing?

omar (EdgeScale): Yes to the quote graphic. We'd be open to a webinar in late May. Our PM will follow up with availability.

sam-engineering: For the brief copy, we should avoid variable numbers. Suggest adding a footnote: "Results may vary based on workload and instance type." That usually satisfies marketplace reviewers.

rob-marketing: Draft copy attached: "Redwood + EdgeScale delivered faster inference and improved cost predictability." I'll create 1200x600 hero and a 600x600 tile using the dark-blue bar for contrast, and export PNGs and a square social version (1200x1200).

legal-bot: Logging: moving edge-permission-v1.pdf to #legal-approvals for signature verification (ref 1781234567). Any future edits to the SVG must be approved by EdgeScale.

nina-ops: Scheduling note: Ops needs the final PNGs and the marketplace description two business days before publish to validate thumbnails. Proposed publish window: May 26-28.

lena: Timeline works. Rob, Sam, please circle back with final assets by EOD May 20 so legal and ops have time. Omar, appreciate the quick uploads.

omar (EdgeScale): Will do. I'll loop in our PM and legal on the webinar and final quote image. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
